snippet.title: Maze Survivor - Trailer English
snippet.description:
Maze Survivor is a survival game set in a procedural maze teeming with monsters. Explore, gather resources, craft items, and upgrade your attributes to escape alive.

The game is under development. The images shown on the page represent the Beta version and may not reflect the quality or content of the final product.
